# Eleene - independent creative studio (elinahovakimyan.com)

> Eleene is an independent, founder-led creative studio. It combines art direction, cinematic storytelling, AI-assisted production and custom digital development to create product and campaign imagery, editorial visuals, cinematic brand films, immersive websites and mobile apps. Work ranges from realistic and minimal to editorial and imaginative. Tagline: "The impossible, beautifully made."

Last updated: 2026-11-05
Canonical site: https://elinahovakimyan.com/
Founder: Elina - creative technologist and visual storyteller, with 8+ years building digital products (40+ apps shipped, 5,500+ students taught)
Contact: enquiry form at https://elinahovakimyan.com/#contact or Instagram https://www.instagram.com/eleene.ai/

## Services (by commission)

1. Product & campaign visuals - product campaign imagery and hero visuals; fashion and beauty editorials; e-commerce and lifestyle product images; social collections and seasonal campaigns; digital and print-ready assets to agreed specifications.
2. Cinematic films & ads - brand films; product commercials and campaign ads; launch teasers and trailers; reels and social cutdowns; episodic branded content.
3. Websites & digital experiences - immersive brand and studio websites; product and collection showcases; editorial portfolios and digital lookbooks; campaign landing pages; custom interactive websites. Designed and developed, not only visual concepts.
4. Mobile apps - iOS and Android apps; MVPs and launches; booking, membership and customer experiences; AI-powered features; redesigns and new functionality.

Services can be commissioned individually or as a connected project (campaign, film and website shaped by one creative vision). Pricing is not published; each project begins with a proposal covering deliverables, timeline, revisions and pricing.

## Who it suits

Fashion, beauty, skincare, fragrance, jewelry, bridal, interior, design, lifestyle and hospitality brands; creative agencies needing campaign production; founders commissioning distinctive websites or mobile products.

## Portfolio (on the homepage)

- Rouge - fashion editorial: one red gown across seven settings, with wardrobe and character consistency.
- Ivory, in bloom - bridal editorial concept in a glasshouse with fabric and silhouette continuity.
- Source - independent spec campaign for a mineral water product (not commissioned by the brand) exploring product storytelling in imagined locations.
- Quiet Hours - naturalistic lifestyle imagery.
- Halo - product campaign for a rose-marble table lamp shown in seven settings (temple, terrace, alcove, ruin, window, lattice of window shadows, passage of arches) with material and form consistency.
- The Screening Room - films including Atelier, The House on the Cliff, Free Fall, and the original micro-drama series Double Booked.
- Websites & apps - full portfolio at https://elinahovakimyan.com/websites-apps.html: live websites Evoria (https://evoria.io) and Aybora (https://aybora.app), the Eleene website itself (live, 2026), and shipped iOS/Android apps Evoria (AI event planning, 2026), Culinar (recipes & meal planning, 2024), Travio (trip planning & maps, 2022), Prehab101 (guided recovery, 2020) and Casana (home & lifestyle, 2019).

## Process

1. The first spark (brief). 2. Finding the direction (vision and scope agreed). 3. Making it real (design, direction, build, milestones). 4. Out into the world (delivery or launch, handover agreed).

## FAQ highlights

- Product accuracy is a priority; work is based on reference images and brand guidelines. If exact reproduction is essential, the production method is agreed first.
- A physical shoot is not always needed; it depends on accuracy, direction and deliverables.
- Usage and licensing are clarified in each project agreement.
- Projects can be run remotely and internationally.
